src: nag bakasyon daw kami panaginip lang naman kasama dogs sa ibang bansa. not sure where exactly tapos at night, may dalawang lalaki nagwawala inaatempt na nakawin yung aso ko. so, to defend, kumuha ako ng lagari and hinampas ko sila and accidentally na tamaan ko yung aso ko.
tgt: We supposedly went on vacation, but it was just a dream where I was with the dogs in another country. I'm not sure where exactly, and then at night, two men were causing a disturbance and trying to steal my dog. So, to defend myself, I grabbed a saw and hit them, and I accidentally hit my dog.

src: which causes three laceration on her back
tgt: Which caused three lacerations on her back.

src: luckily, nahampas ko yung isang guy na nagwawala duguan siya somehow. tapos, later on, nag sumbong daw sila sa pulis. siguro nag take advantage sila since tourist kami. tapos, dumating agad yung pulis sa pinag sstayan namin.
tgt: Luckily, I hit one of the guys who was causing a disturbance, and he was somehow bloody. Then, later on, they supposedly reported us to the police. I guess they took advantage of us since we were tourists. Then, the police immediately arrived at where we were staying.

src: di naman na ako kumawala kasi i know to myself i did nothing. so, ayun, sumama ako sa kanila. tapos pag baba namin ng sasakyan, nagwalkathon pa kami. while walking i was so worried daw sa nbi ko. hahaha. kung mahihirapan ba ako makakuha ganern. haha
tgt: I didn't resist anymore because I knew I did nothing wrong. So, yeah, I went with them. Then when we got out of the car, we had to walk quite a distance. While walking, I was so worried about my NBI clearance. Hahaha. Like, if I would have a hard time getting one or something. Haha.

src: the worriness felt so real, talaga! and at the same time, i was so flirtatious daw. hahaha. nilalandi ko yung guy cops, which happened to be a pinoy too, tsaka yung isang lalaking pumasok sa cr. nag cr muna kasi yung guy cop tapos sinama ako sa loob. hahaha
tgt: The worry felt so real, really! And at the same time, I was supposedly so flirtatious. Hahaha. I was flirting with the guy cops, who happened to be Filipino too, and also with the other guy who went into the restroom. The guy cop went to the restroom first, and then he took me inside with him. Hahaha.

src: afterwards,nandun na kami sa trial court na mukhang barangay lang. hahaha. tapos kaloka, si vp leni yung naging lawyer ko. bongga anek. haha.
tgt: Afterwards, we were already at the trial court, which looked like just a barangay hall. Hahaha. Then, get this, VP Leni became my lawyer. How fabulous! Haha.

src: di ko na alam kung anong nangyari dun bigla na lang ako bumalik sa pinag iistayan namin. tas ayun bumalik na sila kasama sila mama at kuya ko siya nag drive pati na rin yung aso ko. tapos yung result, guilty daw sila. ang galing daw kasi ni vp. hahahahaha
tgt: I don't know what happened there anymore; I suddenly just went back to where we were staying. Then, they came back with my mom and older brother; he was driving, along with my dog. And then the result was, they were guilty. VP was supposedly amazing. Hahahahaha
